title: SICA: Structure Investigation and Condition Assessment for Bridges
description:
SICA (sica-bridge) is a Python package for post-earthquake visual inspection and bridge condition assessment using vision-capable large language models. It assigns R-states (R1-R4) with short explanations to photos of bridge components, then aggregates assessments into component-level and event-level summaries to support inspection and follow-up decisions.

Created and developed by Issac K.T. Pang under the supervision of Professor Khalid M. Mosalam, whose contributions include supervision and project administration. SICA is supported by the STAIRLab (STructural Artificial Intelligence Research Lab) at UC Berkeley.

Source code: github.com/issacpang/sica. Python package: sica-bridge on PyPI.
